i only eat at MY house!

renderer_consumption: scripts/render.js loads the character frame set (idle/blink/ear/chomp/happy/doze — keyed at boot) and swaps them per FSM signals; garden scenes pick by the player's real hour (day master, promoted sunset PNG, runtime-derived night from the day master); the pink room loads per setting. Each opaque frame is chroma-keyed at runtime with the same border flood-fill (pre-baked alpha cutouts remain a future mechanical-key upgrade).
